title: Asking for directions
goal: Ask the way politely and understand and give simple directions with tournez, allez, continuez, traversez and prenez.

blocks.title: On the street in Gatineau
blocks.context: Sofia is looking for the library. She stops a man on the street.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Excusez-moi, monsieur. Pour aller à la bibliothèque, s'il vous plaît ?
lines.en: Excuse me, sir. How do I get to the library, please?

lines.speaker: Monsieur
lines.fr: La bibliothèque ? C'est facile. Allez tout droit jusqu'au feu.
lines.en: The library? It's easy. Go straight ahead as far as the lights.

lines.speaker: Monsieur
lines.fr: Au feu, traversez la rue et tournez à gauche.
lines.en: At the lights, cross the street and turn left.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Je traverse et je tourne à gauche… D'accord. Et après ?
lines.en: I cross and I turn left… OK. And then?

lines.speaker: Monsieur
lines.fr: Prenez la deuxième rue à droite. Continuez tout droit. La bibliothèque est au coin de la rue, en face du parc.
lines.en: Take the second street on the right. Keep going straight. The library is at the corner of the street, opposite the park.

lines.speaker: Monsieur
lines.en: You're welcome. Have a good day!

blocks.body: New little words: [[jusqu'au feu]] (as far as the lights), [[après]] (after, then), [[C'est à cinq minutes]] (it's five minutes away). Notice how Sofia repeats the directions to check: a great habit!

blocks.title: Asking the way
blocks.body:
The simplest polite question is: [[Excusez-moi, pour aller à…, s'il vous plaît ?]] Literally “Excuse me, to go to…, please?” Add the place with the right form of [[à]]:

- [[Pour aller au parc ?]]
- [[Pour aller à la gare ?]]
- [[Pour aller à l'hôpital ?]]

You can also use what you know: [[Où est la banque, s'il vous plaît ?]] or [[Il y a une pharmacie près d'ici ?]]

blocks.title: The imperative: telling someone what to do
blocks.body:
To give directions to a stranger, take the **vous** form of the verb and **drop [[vous]]**:

- [[vous tournez]] → [[Tournez à gauche.]] (Turn left.)
- [[vous allez]] → [[Allez tout droit.]] (Go straight ahead.)

That's it: no new endings to learn. In this lesson we use it only for directions; you'll meet it again later.

blocks.title: Direction verbs
head: vous…
imperative
English
blocks.note: [[prendre]] (to take) is irregular; you know it from [[je vais prendre]] at the café. Next lesson you'll learn more of its forms.

blocks.title: Which street?
blocks.pattern: Prenez la première / deuxième / troisième rue à gauche / à droite.
blocks.note: [[première]] (first) is feminine because [[rue]] is feminine. The others add **-ième** to the number: [[deux]] → [[deuxième]], [[trois]] → [[troisième]] (a final -e drops: [[quatre]] → [[quatrième]]). With a masculine noun: [[le premier feu]] (the first traffic light).

examples.fr: Prenez la première rue à droite.
examples.en: Take the first street on the right.

examples.fr: Prenez la troisième rue à gauche.
examples.en: Take the third street on the left.

examples.fr: Au deuxième feu, tournez à droite.
examples.en: At the second set of lights, turn right.

examples.fr: La pharmacie est au coin de la rue.
examples.en: The pharmacy is at the corner of the street.

blocks.body:
- **Tout droit ≠ à droite:** [[tout droit]] (no -e) = straight ahead. [[à droite]] (with -e) = to the right. Listen for the *t* sound: you hear it in [[droite]], but the t of [[droit]] is silent.
- **Vous forms in real life:** people often give directions with the normal present tense: [[Vous tournez à gauche, vous continuez tout droit…]] It means exactly the same thing.
- **Au feu, not à le feu:** [[à + le]] → [[au]], as you learned last lesson.

blocks.title: Talking to a friend: tu forms
blocks.body:
With a friend, use the **tu** form without [[tu]]. For -er verbs, drop the final **-s**:

- [[tu tournes]] → [[Tourne à gauche !]]
- [[tu continues]] → [[Continue tout droit !]]
- [[tu vas]] → [[Va tout droit !]]
- [[tu prends]] → [[Prends la première rue !]]

For now, just recognize these. Use the [[vous]] forms with strangers.

examples.fr: Traverse la rue et tourne à droite.
examples.en: Cross the street and turn right. (to a friend)

blocks.body:
In everyday Québec French, traffic lights are very often [[les lumières]]: [[Tournez à droite aux lumières.]] The standard words [[le feu]] / [[les feux]] ([[au feu]], [[au feu rouge]]) are used in France and are also understood and used in Québec.

You will also hear street names with [[la rue]], [[le boulevard]] and [[l'avenue]]: [[le boulevard Saint-Laurent]], [[la rue Sainte-Catherine]] in Montréal, [[la rue Principale]] in many small towns.

examples.fr: Aux lumières, prenez la rue Principale à gauche.
examples.en: At the lights, turn left onto rue Principale (Main Street).

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each line out loud. Try to say them as one smooth phrase.

blocks.prompt: Excuse me, how do I get to the bank?
accept: Excusez-moi, pour aller à la banque ?
blocks.explain: [[Pour aller à…]] is the quickest way to ask; [[banque]] is feminine: [[à la banque]].

blocks.explain: [[droit]] (straight) and [[droite]] (right): only the second one has -e.

blocks.prompt: A stranger stops you outside your home: “Excusez-moi, pour aller à la pharmacie ?” Give them directions to a real place near you, in three or four steps.
checklist: At least three imperatives (allez, tournez, prenez…)
One street number: la première / deuxième rue
Where the place is at the end (au coin, en face de…)

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Oui, alors… Allez tout droit jusqu'au feu. Au feu, tournez à gauche. Prenez la deuxième rue à droite. La pharmacie est au coin de la rue, à côté de la banque. C'est à dix minutes.
models.en: Yes, so… Go straight ahead as far as the lights. At the lights, turn left. Take the second street on the right. The pharmacy is at the corner of the street, next to the bank. It's ten minutes away.

blocks.prompt: Friends are coming to your place for a party. Write directions from the nearest bus stop or metro station to your door.
checklist: Start from the bus stop or station
At least three steps with vous imperatives
One landmark (en face du parc, à côté de la banque…)
End with your door or building

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour à tous ! À l'arrêt d'autobus, traversez la rue et allez tout droit. Au coin de la rue, tournez à droite. Prenez la première rue à gauche. Mon appartement est en face du parc, au numéro 12. À samedi ! Raj
models.en: Hi everyone! At the bus stop, cross the street and go straight ahead. At the corner of the street, turn right. Take the first street on the left. My apartment is opposite the park, at number 12. See you Saturday! Raj

summary:
- Ask the way: [[Excusez-moi, pour aller à la gare ?]]
- Give directions with the imperative: [[Tournez, allez, continuez, traversez, prenez]]
- Use [[tout droit, à gauche, à droite, au coin de la rue, au feu, la première rue]]
- Understand short spoken directions
